adversarial_mutation.rationale: Synthetic forward NAND address, malformed AST input and false pass/fail receipt are rejected; hash mismatches and hidden argument paths are guarded.

artifact_and_checker.rationale: Separate scalar AST/NAND interpreters replay all outputs and supplied entry; no producer/assessment imports.

causal_alternatives.rationale: Guided primitive reconstruction and equal-search inline controls retained; no claim separates semantic guidance from a shared locator improvement.

claim_scope.rationale: Supplied component is free, task mathematics reused, CPU results host-specific; later selection/acquisition remains separately paid.

comparator_fairness.rationale: Same labels/order, arm-local initially empty caches; within-stream warm reuse checked. Atomic fallback preserves valid pairs after failed extensions.

identifiability.rationale: Question is prescribed pair location at fixed width, not discovering a new component or identifying new mathematical structures.

independent_replay.rationale: All3840 saved outputs independently scalar-replayed; failed-trial counters checked by receipt identities, not a hidden solver rerun.

information_leakage.rationale: Engine receives truth only; public rows contain id/n/truth; no hints; given entry contains only truth/expr/dag.

representation_robustness.rationale: Fresh paired input renamings checked on all512 original assignments; no extrapolation beyond these representations.

resource_fairness.rationale: 80 fresh one-case worker PIDs, one configured worker, common CPU affinity; paid process/wall receipts recomputed with disclosed exclusions.

scope_and_authority.rationale: Exploratory bounded successor; source/data hashes and prior design match their sealed identities.

split_integrity.rationale: 48 unique labels exclude84 prior exact nine-input tables, with24 paired relabelings; mathematical structures intentionally reused.

statistical_validity.rationale: Eight warm counterbalanced timing blocks and two cold blocks; fixed candidate and strongest predeclared no-library baseline; no retrospective task/repeat selection.

independence: Standalone scalar AST/NAND checker imports no producer, generator or assessment. Reviewer authored a base-solver predecessor; a separate read-only helper checked pre-outcome methodology.
limits: No solver or search reruns. Failed search tests are receipt reaggregation/identity checks, not independent replay of unlogged rejected proposals.
Pair and extension counters are nested: each fresh extension invokes one pair request, which may hit its cache. They are reported separately, not summed as independent work.

Named/flat semantic-placement equality excludes AST construction/remapping and inline-lowering work. Flat's expanded AST can require more remapping; all such work remains in returned counters and paid CPU/wall totals.
Fresh exact labels reuse the predecessor mathematics up to input permutation; no new-structure transfer claim.
Eight timing repeats measure this host/workload, not independent scientific mechanisms.
Given component is free in this locator diagnostic; acquisition and paid selection remain separate.
timing_boundary: Method import/library parsing, construction, solve and circuit JSON; excludes common scientific binding/hash checks, affinity, runner and trace output. Source bytes OS-warmed by common hashing.
